features.title: Humanoid
features.introduction: Explore Humanoid: compare what these SCPs have in common and how their anomalies differ.

articles.title: The Grand Esoteric Cooking Tournament (WITH MECHAS)
articles.blurb: SCP-075-INT is a collection of massive, highly advanced robots and/or vehicles comprised of diverse anomalous technologies and cooking utensils.

articles.title: Wishful Chocolate
articles.blurb: SCP-003-INT is a package of filled chocolates.Wondertainment's Wonderland chocolate bank of true sweetness™" are written in cursive font on the package.

articles.title: The Courier
articles.blurb: Warning, unrecognised credentials.Personal files being decoded… INTERNATIONAL SCP INTEL NETWORK Personal files and ongoing cases Welcome back, Director.

articles.title: Magical Catgirls
articles.blurb: SCP-012-INT designates a group of 6 human women of varied phenotypes.

articles.title: Matté's Village
articles.blurb: It is unknown whether the first inhabitants of the anomaly were aware of its anomalous properties, with little information existing about the beginnings of the village.
